title: MenuCatalogExtractionFailedV1
description: Owner-facing alert (spec 11 §8, Inv-14) emitted on the menu.commands lane when the isolated extractor fails for a clean (scanned) catalog artifact. There is no 'extract_failed' status in the frozen catalog_status enum (decision D4), so the catalog is left stuck in 'extracting' and this event — together with the audit row — is how a failed extraction is surfaced to the owner, never silently dropped. Carries NO secrets, artifact bytes, or transcript text (Inv-12) — only the catalog id and a coarse reason.

message_type.description: Explicit schema discriminator; always 'menu.catalog.extraction_failed.v1' for this contract.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier propagated across the ingestion chain (the catalog id).

causation_id.description: message_id of the ingestion message that caused this alert (nullable).

catalog_id.description: Stable id of the vendor_catalogs row left stuck in 'extracting'.

reason.description: Coarse machine reason for the failure, e.g. 'extraction_failed'. Never raw extractor output or stack trace.
